column1: # Game profile of SD GUNDAM G GENERATION CROSS RAYS (Switch, Platinum Edition: base game + update 1.6.3 = v720896 + 31 DLC, all in one cartridge dump).
# TOM CREATE / Bandai Namco, SDK 9.4.1, NVN. All assets are in /Data.bin (15.14 GB, a CRIWARE container) plus /data/sound (.hca, 21,831 files)
# and /data/movie (CRI USM); the engine is CRIWARE + compiled Lua 5.2, not Unity or Unreal.
# The shaders are not in RomFS: 1090 GLSLC compiler outputs (magic 0x19866891) are compiled into main's read-only segment (173 vs, 917 ps),
# scanned by shader_split.py glslc_shaders. Same shape as 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim, which plays on the iPhone.

column1: # main's nninitStartup sizes its heap as the application pool less "used memory" and calls SetMemoryHeapSize, then
# AllocateMemoryBlock for its own malloc (main+0x5cc4d0). That is the Age of Calamity path (docs/reference/memory.md,
# "Heap sized from the application pool less used memory"): the host reported 64 MB used, this game's modules take
# 0x7800000 (120 MB), so SetHeapSize failed and AllocateMemoryBlock returned 0 — main never checked it and stored
# through null at main+0x5cc508. mem_used is set to the modules plus room (128 MB), as Age of Calamity's 72 MB is.
# Block: 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + the heap region = 4 GB.
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# SDK 9.4.1 is SDK 10 or older, so the host reports NVN API 53.313 on its own (hle_nvn.c nvn_api, DM_SDK_OLD):
# the same path Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity (SDK 9.6.0, Bandai Namco / Koei Tecmo) already runs on. No device_api override needed.
# Boot reaches the title menu and draws 62 draws a frame, but every image is black and only text renders: the game writes
# its texels into a memory pool with the CPU and the host never uploads them. `packaged textures: first uploads 0` in the
# log is the tell. The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles had exactly this black screen, and docs/reference/services.md names
# tex_flush_upload / tex_dirty_upload as its fix (nvn-objects.md, "Mapped-range flushes taken as uploads" and "CPU writes
# with no flush, caught by page protection"). Both are on: this engine flushes some storages and writes others with none.
# The iPhone 16 Pro's screen is 2622x1206 (2.174) against the game's 1920x1080 (1.778), so a letterboxed present leaves
# 239 px of black on each side. `crop` scales to the screen's width and lets the excess height fall outside the viewport:
# shapes stay correct and the game loses 9% of its height at each edge (98 px of the original 1080). `stretch` would
# distort it 22% sideways. The launcher's "Screen fill" setting overrides this per launch.
# The shaders are not in RomFS: 1090 GLSLC compiler outputs (magic 0x19866891) are compiled into main's read-only segment and
# referenced from a {pointer, size, 0} table in .data (shader_split.py glslc_shaders scans main unconditionally).
# Same shape as 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim, which plays on the iPhone; /Data.bin holds the assets, not shaders.
